text: I did two 3 month visits with 6 weeks in between recently and have never had any issues at immigration, but I think there is no guarantee and can be the luck of the draw sometimes with what immigration officer you get. (Also, I’ve always said I’m visiting my partner). I think the main thing they want to know is that you’re not living here on a tourist visa (coming and going all the time and spending most of the year in Israel) but this is just speculation based on personal experience 😌
